scope: Approved specification-led regrouping STEP 1 only: original-file relocation and preservation metadata. No original file has moved or changed.

baseline.order: git ls-tree -r -z at the frozen commit

serialization.json: UTF-8 without BOM, ensure_ascii=true, indent=4, allow_nan=false, insertion-order keys, one final LF
serialization.pathConvention: Repository paths and logical artifacts use Git slash notation; resolve native filesystem paths by splitting components.
serialization.selfDigest: Excluded from this JSON. The SHA-256 of all JSON representation bytes is anchored in relocation-plan.md.
serialization.relocationRowsSerialization: Baseline TSV with destinationPath<TAB>classification<TAB> inserted after originalPath<TAB>.
serialization.researchProposedRowsComparison: Not a byte-comparable serialization: this ledger uses the requested eight classification tokens, combining AV/ONVIF normative rows and retaining owner separately. Full destinations and family counts are checked against the approved matrix; the original 909-row baseline digest matches exactly.

newMetadata.movePhaseTreatment: Retain in place; skip when iterating the 909 original entries.
Retain in place; skip when iterating the 909 original entries.

plannedAuthority.rule: These are initial placement/ownership declarations, not new semantics. Root Markdown will state authority and annex limits; generated views and reference-runtime code must not become competing normative prose.

av-authored.role: Authored AV prose, sole term inventory, examples, supporting material and tools.

onvif-authored.role: Authored source/requirement inventories and retained prose/runtime/tool inputs; independent specification consolidation remains separate.

shared-authored.role: Shared metadata/workflows only; no third root specification.

av-generator.role: Generated projections/reference/examples/publication metadata; never hand-rewrite protected history.

onvif-canonical-generator.role: Generated native models, vocabulary, schemas, indexes and supporting views.

preservation-only.role: Exact committed and working representation bytes, modes and historical/source coordinates; no generation or path rewriting.

allowedActiveTransformKinds.active-local-references: Reviewed repository-relative links, example file/JSON-Pointer coordinates and local loader paths only.
allowedActiveTransformKinds.repository-admin-paths: Reviewed shared ownership paths/globs, workflow commands and new output ignores; retain legacy local/cache ignores and exact-byte policies.
allowedActiveTransformKinds.tool-and-test-paths: Reviewed tool roots, imports, fixture locations, isolated test configuration and command paths only.
allowedActiveTransformKinds.workspace-and-staging-paths: Reviewed workspace/lock link keys, scripts and explicit physical-resource maps; preserve dependency pins, package exports and logical paths.
allowedActiveTransformKinds.native-build-and-source-map: Reviewed CMake/include/preparation paths and complete 43-key source map; preserve all seven CTest targets and build containment.
allowedActiveTransformKinds.owned-generated-relocation-metadata: Regenerate with the existing named owner only after reviewed physical-locator edits; audit digest propagation without semantic or identity changes.
allowedActiveTransformKinds.active-source-lock-locators: Only top-level repository locators may be rebased; source relativePath, IDs, hashes, bytes, native imports and notice relationships remain fixed.

prohibited: Blanket string replacements over namespaces, IDs, tm:ref, schema $id/$ref, native URLs, package exports or archived coordinates.
Any archived, vendored, notice, protected native-patch or contextual-attribute byte rewrite.
Silent deletion, merge, flattening collision, stale-manifest cleanup outside explicit physical ownership, or lost source-fingerprint input.
Semantic changes, new model identities, adapter implementation, SOAP facades, generation, publication or qualification claims in STEP 1.
transformPolicy.laterTransformationEvidence: Each reviewed changed destination needs its originalPath, transform kind, reason, resulting byte count/SHA-256 and applicable gates in a separate migration result; do not rewrite this frozen baseline.

nativePatch.rule: Move the unchanged contextual .gitattributes with its native project; patch-relative placement stays identical. No normalization of the tracked patch is allowed.

nativeCohort.fingerprintSerialization: Existing cohort_gate.fingerprint: json.dumps(source-key-to-sha256, sort_keys=True), default separators, UTF-8, no trailing LF.
nativeCohort.rule: Keep all 43 original keys when resolving relocated physical sources, including 23 inputs outside the new native project root. Later reviewed source edits legitimately change hashes, never membership silently.

packageStaging.rule: Resolve logicalArtifactPath through physicalArtifactSources, never by flattening it. Per-entry packageResourcePaths are package-relative, not repository destinations.
packageStaging.boundary: No package staging occurred. Existing dist/catalog-data flat and hierarchical copies, source-documents, exports, CLI and dependency pins remain distinct.

identityPins.rule: Filesystem paths are not public identifiers. Preserve namespaces, term IRIs, TM IDs/imports, schema IDs, source relativePath and package logical resources. Abstract/native model separation requires a later explicitly versioned change.

ignoredLocalState.scope: Excluded: all ignored and non-original untracked contents. Counts and hashes of private/SDK/environment descendants are deliberately not collected.
ignoredLocalState.moveRule: Move explicit tracked files only in a later phase, never whole old parent directories. Existing new-path parent directories are allowed if safe; existing destination files are not overwritten.

laterAdditionsNotCreatedHere.role: New two-specification navigator, after preserving the old overview.
New authoritative ONVIF Markdown; not one of the old 17 support documents.
Later support navigation may cross-link to av/support/research; do not duplicate its 94 files.

validationGates.F: Session-only freeze tool: raw committed blobs, worktree hashes, index/modes, collision checks, resource/native maps and canonical ledger bytes; executed for STEP 1.
validationGates.A: Future relocated AV generation/check_docs/validate behavior gates.
validationGates.H: Future external archive verifier; never run or reseal historical generators.
validationGates.N: Future source-lock and unit/catalog gates; note that canonical check commands may stage/build.
validationGates.L: Future existing loopback/native binding, event, discovery and publication suites.
validationGates.P: Future isolated installed-package proof with unchanged logical paths, exports and pins.
validationGates.C: Future explicitly provisioned native cohort with all 43 source inputs and seven CTest targets.
validationGates.D: Future both-specification Markdown/HTML/local-link checks excluding immutable interiors.
